_note: Candidate organic active-layer materials, kept for future studies. This file is NOT loaded by the simulation (only detector-stack.json is parsed). To study one of these as an active layer, copy its block into detector-stack.json and set its thickness/lateral_mm/position for that study. Thickness and lateral_mm here are placeholders (200 nm x 2.8 mm, matching a PEDOT-like sense layer); adjust per study. These were previously being built unintentionally as 1 um parasitic layers because the JSON parser ignored // comments; they are now removed from the active stack.
